title: Lookup
summary: A form field that picks people or objects from a search the host answers: type, see rows with a picture, a name and a caption, choose one or several. Chosen items are removable chips; the list says when it waits for more letters, searches, finds nothing, is unavailable or failed, with a retry.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

size.description: The field ladder, as sf-input's: the frame, the padding and the text of the same size; the chips stand on the field's text line, the rows' pictures a rung below.

appearance.description: How the field looks: a bordered box or a filled one, sf-input's two boxes.

label.description: The visible name of the field; it names the search box and the list. Without it the host's aria-label does.

placeholder.description: Shown in the search box while it is empty.

hint.description: The line under the field; it describes the search box.

name.description: The form name: one entry with the chosen value, or one entry per chosen value when multiple. Only the values are sent, never the labels.

multiple.description: Several items, shown as removable chips in the order chosen; the list stays open after a choice. Without it a choice is the value and closes the list.

max-items.description: Multiple only: the most items that may be chosen (49 for a group). A choice past it is refused with a visible line; 0 is no cap.

min-length.description: The fewest characters the provider is asked with; below it the list shows the hint and nothing is asked. Inline options are searched at any length.

max-results.description: The limit the provider is asked for, and the most items one answer shows.

debounce.description: Milliseconds the field waits after the last key before it asks the provider, as sf-search.

maxlength.description: The most characters the search box takes (80 for simai.chat); 0 is no limit.

required.description: The form is not sent while nothing is chosen (value-missing).

disabled.description: Not searched, not changed, not focusable and not sent with the form; a disabled fieldset does the same.

readonly.description: The chosen items are shown and sent, but not changed: no search, no remove buttons.

invalid.description: The page's verdict: the error look and aria-invalid, with error-message under the field.

error-message.description: Shown in place of the hint while invalid.

options.description: A short list given whole, [{value, label, caption?, avatar?}]: searched in place, the provider never asked. A property, or the data-sf-settings island.

exclude.description: Values left out of every answer and of the inline options (the reader, the current members); the component filters them. A property, or the data-sf-settings island.

provider.description: The search: async function (query, {cursor, limit, signal}) answering {items: [{value, label, caption?, avatar?: {src} | {initials}}], nextCursor?, notice?} or {status: 'unavailable'}; notice is a line of the host's own under the rows (first 20 shown, narrow your search); a thrown error or a rejected promise is the error state. The previous call is aborted through signal and its late answer dropped. A property only.

value.description: Single: {value, label} or null. Multiple: a list of {value, label} in the order chosen, [] when nothing is. A chosen item keeps its caption and avatar. Set from code (or the value attribute as JSON; a bare value is read against the options) it says nothing.

search.summary: Puts a query in the search box and searches it as typing does, at once (no debounce), opening the list. Returns false while disabled or read-only.

retry.summary: Repeats the last call to the provider, with its query and cursor, as the Retry button does. Returns false when there is nothing to repeat.

close.summary: Closes the list and drops a search still running; the query stays.

input.summary: The value changed: a choice, a chip removed, Backspace in the empty search box. Sent before change, with the same detail; the search box's own input does not leave the host.

change.summary: The value changed by the person, once per choice or removal, as a select's: detail.value is the new value, detail.item the item chosen or removed, detail.action added, removed or replaced. A value set from code, a form reset and a restore say nothing.

keyboard: Typing searches; ArrowDown opens the list and moves down, ArrowUp moves up, Home and End go to the ends while it is open
Enter chooses the active row; in a single field it closes the list
Escape closes the list; a second Escape clears the query
Backspace in the empty search box removes the last chip
Tab reaches each chip's remove button and leaves the field
accessibility.focus: Focus stays in the search box while the list is open; the active row is said through aria-activedescendant. The frame draws the focus ring while the box has keyboard focus; a click into it draws none. Removing a chip gives focus back to the search box.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-lookup to choose people or objects from a set the host searches -- members of a chat, an assignee, a linked record -- or from a short list given whole.
do_not: Do not fetch inside the component or give it a URL: give it a provider function and answer {items, nextCursor} or {status: 'unavailable'}
Do not trust the submitted values on the server: check that the person may choose them
Do not use it for a fixed list of a few words without search; use sf-dropdown, sf-radio or sf-button-group
Do not use it for site search; use sf-search
ai_guidance.minimal_example:
<sf-lookup label="Members" name="members" multiple max-items="49"></sf-lookup>
<script>document.querySelector('sf-lookup').provider = async (query, {cursor, limit, signal}) => (await fetch(`/api/people?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=${limit}`, {signal})).json();</script>
